docker-lab-server.name: Docker lab server (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
docker-lab-server.notes: The one machine of the docker-lab (vms/labs/docker-lab/): Docker Engine and the Compose plugin from Ubuntu's archive, the lab user in the docker group. The post-install pre-pulls the two small images the exercises and tests use (alpine:3.20, nginx:1.27-alpine), so a run is not exposed to Docker Hub's rate limit. Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image. Ported from qlab's docker-lab.

post_install_run: sudo docker image inspect alpine:3.20 nginx:1.27-alpine >/dev/null
